mapper.sql: i.invoice_id, i.invoice_no, i.direction_cd, i.vendor_id, v.company_nm AS vendor_nm, i.biz_contract_id, c.title AS contract_title, i.schedule_id, i.issue_dt, i.due_dt, i.amount_net, i.vat_amount, i.amount_total, i.paid_amount, i.remaining_amount, i.tax_invoice_yn, i.status_cd, i.owner_user_id, u.name AS owner_name, i.memo, i.attach_group_id, i.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_invoice (invoice_no, direction_cd, vendor_id, biz_contract_id, schedule_id, issue_dt, due_dt, amount_net, vat_amount, amount_total, paid_amount, remaining_amount, tax_invoice_yn, status_cd, owner_user_id, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{invoiceNo}, #{directionCd}, #{vendorId}, #{bizContractId}, #{scheduleId}, #{issueDt}, #{dueDt}, #{amountNet}, #{vatAmount}, #{amountTotal}, 0, #{amountTotal}, COALESCE(#{taxInvoiceYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{statusCd},'DRAFT'), #{ownerUserId}, #{memo}, #{ownerUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_invoice SET vendor_id = #{vendorId}, biz_contract_id = #{bizContractId}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, issue_dt = #{issueDt}, due_dt = #{dueDt}, amount_net = #{amountNet}, vat_amount = #{vatAmount}, amount_total = #{amountTotal}, remaining_amount = #{amountTotal} - paid_amount, tax_invoice_yn = #{taxInvoiceYn}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_invoice SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE gw_invoice SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE gw_invoice SET status_cd = 'ISSUED', issue_dt = COALESCE(issue_dt, CURRENT_DATE) WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND status_cd = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE gw_invoice SET paid_amount = paid_amount + #{paidDelta}, remaining_amount = amount_total - (paid_amount + #{paidDelta}), status_cd = CASE WHEN amount_total - (paid_amount + #{paidDelta}) <= 0 THEN 'PAID' WHEN (paid_amount + #{paidDelta}) > 0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_PAID' ELSE status_cd END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND paid_amount + #{paidDelta} <= amount_total AND paid_amount + #{paidDelta} >= 0
UPDATE gw_invoice SET status_cd = 'OVERDUE' WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND due_dt IS NOT NULL AND due_dt < CURRENT_DATE AND status_cd IN ('ISSUED','PARTIALLY_PAID') AND remaining_amount > 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_invoice i JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id LEFT JOIN gw_biz_contract c ON c.biz_contract_id = i.biz_contract_id LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = i.owner_user_id WHERE i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM gw_invoice i JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id LEFT JOIN gw_biz_contract c ON c.biz_contract_id = i.biz_contract_id LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = i.owner_user_id
ORDER BY i.issue_dt DESC, i.invoice_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_invoice i JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount_total), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(remaining_amount), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM gw_invoice WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND direction_cd = #{directionCd} AND status_cd <> 'CANCELED'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(remaining_amount), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM gw_invoice WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND direction_cd = #{directionCd} AND status_cd IN ('ISSUED','PARTIALLY_PAID','OVERDUE')

SELECT FORMATDATETIME(issue_dt, 'yyyy-MM') AS ym, COALESCE(SUM(amount_total), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM gw_invoice WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND direction_cd = #{directionCd} AND issue_dt >= DATEADD('MONTH', -#{months}, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY FORMATDATETIME(issue_dt, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY FORMATDATETIME(issue_dt, 'yyyy-MM')

SELECT v.vendor_id AS vendor_id, v.company_nm AS vendor_nm, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount_total), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(i.remaining_amount), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM gw_invoice i JOIN gw_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.direction_cd = #{directionCd} GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.company_nm ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
